properties.description:
Resolves an array of User IDs into full User objects using a "Cache-Aside" pattern. To optimize performance, it retrieves known users from a local cache and performs a single batch network request for any missing IDs.
- **idArr**: An array of User IDs to be resolved (e.g., `[1, 2, 5]`).
- **Returns**: A `Promise` that resolves to an array of User objects, maintaining the exact same order as the input array.
